name: Gold leaf, edible (23-24 karat)
source: Edible gold leaf is 958-999 fine gold (23-24 karat), with the balance a trace silver/copper alloy.
notes: Gold (Au) is not among this simulation's tracked elements (see core/commodity.ts) — bakery-relevant conserved quantities are C, H, O, N, P, K, S, Na, Cl, Ca, Mg, Fe, plus the Ash catch-all for everything else.
